name: Siphon
description: Bring Stremio catalogs, metadata, subtitles and stream versions to native Jellyfin libraries.

versions.changelog: Siphon 1.5.0.0: private user addon profiles, native collections and saved additions, selected-version HTTP/P2P downloads, source and metadata diagnostics, selective history recovery, followed-series calendar and opt-in notifications, targeted synchronization, provider quotas and shared caching, IntroDB timings, and bounded opt-in P2P playback. Includes media-response validation and the unchanged supplied icon. Persistent offline queues, offline HLS exports and external webhooks remain unreleased 1.6 features.
